description:
In this video, we take you on a walkaround of the 2026 Ducati Panigale V4 R at EICMA with all the specs you need to know. A street-legal race beast with aggressive aerodynamics and cutting-edge electronics.

What feature caught your eye the most on this bike? Would you ride something this extreme on the road or save it just for the track?
